{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel to ensure comparability
segment_by_channel = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])

# Check the distribution of customer_age by channel
age_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['customer_age'].describe()

# Print results
segment_by_channel, age_by_channel"}
